name: Daily SSOP Inspection (USDA)
description: Instructions: QA Technician inspects USDA processing areas for the following items. Correct and document nonconformities. Report recurring issues to management. Revision 14, 07/21/2025.

fields.label: Inspection items
fixedRows: a. Inspect equipment, FCS, and utensils for cleanliness.
b. Inspect utensils and containers for cracks or chips.
c. Inspect floors, walls, doors, and ceilings for cleanliness.
d. Verify accuracy of monitoring equipment/devices (X-ray, scales, O2 is turn on).

fields.label: Inspection items
fixedRows: a. Handwashing: Employees washing hands before entering work area. Sink is working. Soap, paper towels, hand sanitizer full.
b. GMP: PPE being worn and changed properly. No jewelry being worn.
c. Ingredients, WIP, and finished products are properly labeled and stored/used within time constraint. Ingredients and WIP are enclosed/covered when not in use.
d. Dispose trash and unused materials from area.
e. Check QUAT sanitizer strength in production room. Replace sanitizer if concentration is out of target range (200 [light green] < ppm < 400 [light green]). (< 200 [yellow], > 400 [green]).
f. Inspect utensils and containers for cracks or chips. Inspect bags of product being used. Check for seepage, tears, rips, improper opening of bags by employees, etc.
